title: Paleo Chicken and Vegetable Tray Bake
steps: Preheat the oven to 220°C (200°C fan-forced) and line a large baking tray with baking paper.

Cut the sweet potato into 2 cm chunks, the carrots into thick batons, the red onion into wedges and the red capsicum into chunky pieces. Cut the broccoli into florets and peel the garlic cloves, leaving them whole.

Toss the sweet potato, carrots, onion and garlic on the tray with half the olive oil, the dried rosemary, the dried thyme and a good pinch of salt and pepper. Roast for 10 minutes to give the dense vegetables a head start.
Meanwhile, toss the chicken thigh fillets in a bowl with the remaining olive oil, the apple cider vinegar and a pinch of salt and pepper.
Add the broccoli and capsicum to the tray, toss to coat in the pan juices, then nestle the chicken among the vegetables so it sits slightly on top.
Roast for 30 minutes, turning the chicken and stirring the vegetables once halfway, until the chicken is cooked through and the vegetables are tender.
Switch the oven to grill and cook for a final 3 minutes to brown the chicken.
Rest for 5 minutes, then serve straight from the tray.
